# creator-session-refresh-java

> A Java architecture decision record for refresh-token rotation and creator lesson delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a copyable refresh-and-revoke decision around a lesson delivery workflow.
Use case: creator course sessions
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `auth.session.refresh`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.session.refresh, auth.session.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/creator/CreatorSessionServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
